message.content:
Read the single-file browser game at /config/workspace/games/zelena-imperija/zelena-imperija.html.
It is a FarmVille-style cannabis-growing tycoon game. Design spec: /config/workspace/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-02-zelena-imperija-design.md.
All player-facing text is Macedonian Cyrillic; all code identifiers are Latin-transliterated
Macedonian (zasadiSemka, parichnik, presmetajKvalitet). This is deliberate — do NOT report
the Macedonian naming or the Macedonian UI as a problem, and do not suggest renaming to English.
It must stay ONE self-contained file with no external assets, no build step, no network calls —
do NOT suggest splitting it into modules, adding a bundler, or adding dependencies.
Report ONLY concrete defects you can point at in the actual code. No speculation, no style
preferences, no "consider adding tests". If you find nothing real in your lens, return an empty list.

YOUR LENS: JavaScript correctness in the browser.
Check: the tick loop and its delta-time catch-up; state mutation during iteration; stale
references after vchitaj() replaces the sostojba object; the dirty-flag panel rendering;
DOM node caching in lejaJazli versus izgradiLei being called again; inline onclick handlers
resolving against globals under "use strict"; SVG attribute vs CSS transform handling;
number formatting with toLocaleString('mk-MK'); localStorage failure paths; the save/load
round trip and field normalisation; any place a NaN or undefined can enter state; event
listener or setTimeout leaks from izvesti(); and whether iscrtajSe() can throw for any
reachable state (empty bed, locked bed, unknown strain, plant at zdravje 0, faza missing).
Report only defects with a concrete reproduction.

content.text: I read the full file. Here is what I found.

findings.title: Overripe penalty is inert — passive recovery is 2× larger, so an overripe plant never loses health
findings.location: tikni(), the `else { r.faza = "ZRELO"; ... }` branch — `r.zdravje = stegni(r.zdravje - KONFIG.KAZNA_PREZRELOST_DEN * delDena, 0, 100);`
findings.problem: The overripe penalty is the only health term scaled by `delDena` (0.125), giving 1.5 health/day. Every other health term is applied per tick: `OPORAVUVANJE` (0.4) is added once per tick = 3.2 health/day. The overripe branch also does not set `dobro = false`, so recovery still applies. Net change for an overripe but otherwise well-tended plant is `+0.4 - 0.1875 = +0.2125` per tick, i.e. health climbs and pins at 100. The comment on the line above ("Презревањето трајно го симнува квалитетот преку здравјето") and the `TEKST.prezrelo` warning both promise a consequence that the code can never deliver.
findings.failure_scenario: Plant Скопско Зелено, keep water/nutrients in range (or buy `navodnuvanje` + `rabotnik`, after which it is automatic). Let the plant sit past `CHASA_ZRELO_PROZOR` (14 game days after ripening ≈ 28 real seconds). The ⚠️ toast fires once, but `r.zdravje` stays at 100 indefinitely, `zbirZdravje/brojTikovi` stays ~100, and harvesting after 100 overripe days yields exactly the same quality/grade as harvesting on the first ripe tick. Waiting is strictly free.
findings.fix: In the ZRELO branch, when `preku > 0`, set `dobro = false` before the recovery check (move the overripe block above the `if (dobro) delta += KONFIG.OPORAVUVANJE;` line and fold the penalty into `delta`), and drop the `* delDena` scaling so the penalty is per-tick like `STETA_SUSA`/`OPORAVUVANJE` — e.g. `delta -= KONFIG.KAZNA_PREZRELOST_DEN; dobro = false;`.

findings.title: Side panel innerHTML is rebuilt every game day (~2 real seconds), resetting scroll and swallowing in-flight clicks
findings.location: iscrtajPanel() — `el.innerHTML = panelProdavnica()` / `panelSushara()` / `panelMagacin()` / `panelNadgradbi()`; dirty flag set by `if (novDen){ ... panelValjaSe = true; }` in tikni()
findings.problem: `panelValjaSe` is set unconditionally on every new game day by the market-drift block, and additionally by the sushara loop whenever `Math.floor(serija.denovi)` changes. A game day is 8 ticks = 2 real seconds, so `#sodrzina.innerHTML` is wholesale replaced at least every 2 s no matter which tab is open. `#sodrzina` is the scroll container (`max-height:calc(100vh - 190px); overflow-y:auto`), so replacing its children collapses content height and resets `scrollTop` to 0. It also destroys every button node in the panel, so any click whose mousedown and mouseup straddle a rebuild never produces a `click` event. The in-place comparison guard that `postaviAkcii()` uses for bed buttons has no equivalent here.
findings.failure_scenario: Harvest and dry ~8 batches so the Магацин list overflows the panel. Open Магацин and scroll to the bottom to reach the last batch's Продај button. Every ~2 seconds the list jumps back to the top mid-interaction; and roughly one press in twenty is dropped entirely (button visually depresses, nothing happens) because the node was replaced between mousedown and mouseup.
findings.fix: In `iscrtajPanel()`, preserve scroll and skip no-op writes: `const el = document.getElementById("sodrzina"); const skrol = el.scrollTop; const html = (aktivnoJazice === "prodavnica") ? panelProdavnica() : ...; if (el.innerHTML !== html) { el.innerHTML = html; el.scrollTop = skrol; }`

findings.title: localStorage failure re-notifies forever — a toast every 10 seconds for the whole session
findings.location: zachuvaj() — `catch(e){ izvesti(TEKST.sejvGreska, "greska"); }`, driven by `if (++brojacTikovi % KONFIG.AVTOSEJV_TIKOVI === 0) zachuvaj();`
findings.problem: Autosave runs every `AVTOSEJV_TIKOVI` (40) ticks = every 10 real seconds. When `localStorage.setItem` throws — storage disabled by cookie/site-data blocking, Safari private browsing, or `QuotaExceededError` — the catch fires an error toast every single time, with no once-only guard. The failure condition is permanent for the session, so the user gets an unbounded stream of identical red toasts (each living 3.6 s, so 1–2 are always on screen) covering the bottom-right corner for as long as the tab is open, plus one more on `beforeunload`.
findings.failure_scenario: Open the game in Chrome with "Block all cookies"/site data blocked for the origin (or Safari Private Browsing). `localStorage.setItem` throws on every autosave. From 10 seconds in, a "Зачувувањето не успеа" toast appears every 10 seconds indefinitely and permanently occludes the notification corner.
findings.fix: Add a module-scope flag and warn once: `let sejvOtkazan = false;` then in the catch `if (!sejvOtkazan){ sejvOtkazan = true; izvesti(TEKST.sejvGreska, "greska"); }` (optionally skip further `setItem` attempts once the flag is set).

findings.title: vchitaj() merges `statistika` from the save unvalidated, letting NaN/undefined into state and the HUD
findings.problem: Every other field in `vchitaj()` is guarded with `Number.isFinite` (the inline comment even states the goal: "за оштетен сејв да не внесе NaN во парите"), but `statistika` is merged wholesale. Any non-numeric or missing-but-present value in the saved object is copied straight into live state. `sostojba.statistika.vkupnoGrama` is then rendered as `Math.round(sostojba.statistika.vkupnoGrama) + " г"`, and `zavrsiSushenje` does `+= grama` on it, so a bad value is sticky and gets written back by the next autosave.
findings.failure_scenario: With a corrupted/hand-edited save, set `s.statistika.vkupnoGrama` to `null` or `"120"` in `localStorage["zelena-imperija-sejv"]` and reload. The HUD "Вкупна берба" shows `NaN г` (or, for the string case, becomes NaN after the first `+=` in `zavrsiSushenje`) and stays that way for every subsequent session, since the poisoned value is re-saved.
findings.fix: Validate each field the same way the rest of the loader does, e.g. `const st = s.statistika || {}; const broj = (v, d) => Number.isFinite(v) && v >= 0 ? v : d; sostojba.statistika = { vkupnoBerbi: broj(st.vkupnoBerbi, 0), vkupnoGrama: broj(st.vkupnoGrama, 0), vkupnoZaraboteno: broj(st.vkupnoZaraboteno, 0) };`
